method: Each cached .crate archive SHA256 matches the exact package checksum in the workspace Cargo.lock. Local Cargo.toml and .cargo_vcs_info bytes also match the immutable cached archive.
Read package repository/homepage and publication VCS commit/path metadata. Query GitHub trees/files only at those commits. No latest/default branch license substitutions.

For four legacy packages without publication VCS metadata, resolve exact version tags; compare published source-file Git blob hashes. SQLite-vec manifest template plus tagged VERSION reproduces published Cargo.toml.orig exactly, and main C source matches tagged root file.

Save candidate upstream notice bytes in work only; verify their Git blob SHA1 against pinned tree, and record SHA256. Full-text classifications are explicit content observations, not legal determinations.
Follow inherited manifest versions through the pinned workspace Cargo.toml. Mark missing roots, guidance-only files, dirty publication and inaccessible source commits honestly.
limitations: The canonical inventory and application/Cargo/runtime sources are not modified by this research.
This does not establish which all-target inventory crates are linked into a specific final executable, nor satisfy all transitive/bundled-source notice obligations.
A full-text candidate is not a selected license alternative or legal/release acceptance; applicability and copyright/NOTICE retention require review.
Documentation-specific and embedded third-party notices are kept separately. License summaries/links and SPDX metadata are not counted as full license texts.

Publication metadata for audio-core0.2.1 has dirty=true. pathfinder_geometry0.5.1 publication commit cannot be retrieved from declared repository. Newer objc2 source contains licensing links and Apple SDK caveats, not complete license text.
No generic SPDX template or latest-branch file is silently substituted for absent upstream version-specific text.
